title: Master fix — Atlas special runs: Variation + Variation Description cleared on the 6 new rows whose number the tab already has on a different car
why: The Office holds a number the tab already has unless the row carries Variation Details, and then gives it the next open variation. Atlas O leaves Variation and Variation Description blank on every one of its 13,198 rows (773 numbers have two or more rows, told apart by their descriptions), so the 6 new rows are put in the tab's own style: both cells blank. The existing rows of those numbers are not touched. Each new row's Notes says the catalog also has the number on a different car.
said: [stated] Brad 2026-11-25 08:48 CT "yes" (add all 6 under the number Atlas lists, each with a note that the same number is also on a different car; the existing rows stay untouched).
